title: UP Teacher Transfer Online Form 2021 Last Date : 02/07/2021
organization: Basic / Secondary Education Department, Uttar Pradesh
postName: UP Teacher Inter-District / Transfer Online Application 2021
selectionProcess: Online registration / application as per portal process
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, photo ID, mobile number, email, supporting certificates as required
howToApply:
1. Visit official UP Teacher Transfer portal (as notified by Basic/Secondary Education)
2. Login with teacher ID / credentials
3. Fill transfer preferences
4. Upload supporting documents if required
5. Submit before 02 July 2021 (that cycle)
shortDescription: UP Teacher Transfer Online Form 2021 – last date was 02 July 2021. Check education department portal for new transfer drives.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Teacher Transfer applications are invited online for inter-district / mutual transfers of government teachers as per departmental rules.

The 2021 window closed on 02 July 2021. Serving teachers should watch Basic Shiksha / Madhyamik portals for fresh transfer circulars each year.
